kaikki_vikisozluk.e: خِيَارَانِ أَحْلَاهُمَا مُرّ • (ḵiyārāni ʔaḥlāhumā murr) m du
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Literally, “two options the sweeter of which is bitter”.
s: “two options the sweeter of which is bitter”
Literally, “two options the sweeter of which is bitter”
g: a choice between two unpleasant alternatives; expresses between a rock and a hard place, between the hammer and the anvil, between the devil and the deep blue sea
